Mail Car
1st Class Passenger Car
2nd Class Passenger Car
Troop Carrier
Track Maintenance Car
Dining Car
Presidential Car

Missing ties added to straight sections of the track in all levels and tutorial lessons
Improvement of the images of all Levels and Locomotives in the “Play a Level” menu

notes.title: Micro Update 1.1b
notes.content:
The game intro animation can now be skipped from the very beginning by pressing the mouse or keyboard.
 The animations in the Main and Player Menus have been speed up to allow for a more efficient navigation.
 The replay level title animation has been speed up for efficiency purposes.
 A minor issue with the fuel on the tender of the locomotive has been fixed.

notes.title: Update 1.1a
notes.content:
New Steam Achievement added.
New Steam Leaderboard added.
Condensed Mode (F11 key) added.
Goodies Watch operation improved.
Switches appearance improved.
And more...

notes.title: New Upcoming Update 1.1a
notes.content:
New Steam Achievement added:
The achievement “I Believe!” will be unlocked when the player approaches, with his locomotive, a flying saucer landed in one of the levels.
Steam Leaderboard added:
The leaderboard “Loco-Sort Tycoons” will always be updated when the player increases the total cash in hand. When the game is completed, everything the player owns (locomotives, upgrades, paint jobs, services and stars) are converted into cash and the leaderboard will be updated with the final cash.
Condensed Mode (F11 key) added:
When the Condensed Mode is activated, the “Speedometer”, “Steam Timer”, “Train Manifest” and the “Goodies Watch” will become smaller, allowing for a better visualization of the gaming space.
Goodies Watch operation improved:
When the player hides the Goodies Watch, it will remain hidden even when the player opens a special box with a goody.
Switches appearance improved:
The switches had a missing tie that has now been added.
The options in the Main and Player Menus now have literal meanings:

"Play til your heart's content" > "Start"
"Grandiose Locopedia" > "Locomotives & Cars"
"Triumphant Successes" > "High Scores"
"Your Humble Servants" > "Credits"
"Play with Confidence" > "Play a Level"
"File Cabinet" > "Game Files"
